group: Nexuni - Co-Founder / Founding Member of Technical Staff
description: Co-founded and scaled a 40+ person startup, leading and executing key projects in full-stack infrastructure, autonomous robotics, and Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) systems.

roles.title: DoDay - Automation Dessert Store
roles.description: Engineered a hybrid full-stack architecture featuring a Qt5 payment interface and AWS cloud backend for automation store (DoDay) operations to ensure 100% service continuity over 6 years, eliminating revenue loss and scaling the solution to 50+ commercial parking locations.

roles.title: Unitree Go2 - Autonomous Patrolling Robot
roles.description: Deployed a ROS 2-based interface and WebRTC/RTSP dashboard for Unitree Go2 to enable low-latency monitoring and real-time point-and-click path planning, achieving successful commercialization as an autonomous patrolling system in major Singapore shopping malls.

roles.title: Teleoperation System for Unitree G1 Humanoid Robots
roles.description: Developed a teleoperation system integrating Unitree G1 humanoid robots with Meta Quest to facilitate immersive hand-tracking control, leveraging custom gesture recognition for high-precision remote manipulation.

roles.title: RL Training Pipeline for Quadruped Robots
roles.description: Developed an RL training pipeline and policy in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for quadruped robots to master complex vertical stair climbing, significantly improving robustness and navigation performance on high-difficulty terrains.

roles.title: PhantomX Arm - ROS 2 Control Package
roles.description: Created a standalone ROS 2 control package from scratch for the PhantomX arm to provide the only available ROS 2 support for this platform, achieving real-time teleoperation via Unity and Meta Quest.

roles.title: Timber Tensegrity Chair - Robotic Fabrication
roles.description: Designed collision-aware toolpaths for large-scale timber processing on an ABB IRB 6700 to automate industrial wood cutting, translating complex geometric data into executable RAPID code via RobotStudio.

roles.title: Human-Robot Collaborative Assembly - Robotic Fabrication
roles.description: Implemented a low-latency robotic control interface using ABB EGM (Externally Guided Motion) to facilitate high-speed Python API control, integrating HoloLens 2 hand-tracking for real-time human-robot collaborative assembly on the ABB IRB 120.
